$comment: [[D-CSUBSET-VLA-SIZEOF-TYPEFORM]] part (1): `sizeof ( int[n] )` -- the VLA TYPE-NAME form, the ONE `sizeof` whose operand C 6.5.3.4p2 EVALUATES. ★★ THE PROPERTY THIS WITNESS PINS IS FRESH EVALUATION, NOT THE NUMBER: `n` changes between two identical `sizeof(int[n])` expressions and the two answers must DIFFER (12 then 20), which is exactly what a constant-folded implementation cannot do and what a single-value test would never catch. The other five arms are the discriminations a one-arm example would miss -- a FIXED-array control (`sizeof(int[4])` must stay a static 16, so arm 1 cannot be 'passing' by having made every sizeof runtime); the operand's SIDE EFFECT (`sizeof(int[n++])` really increments n, the sharpest discriminator in C for this feature); the MULTIDIMENSIONAL form (`int[n][m]` and the mixed `int[n][3]`, so a fix that handled one bound and mis-answered two cannot read as complete); SUFFIX-to-LEVEL pairing (`typedef int Row[3]; sizeof(Row[n])` is 6*12, not 6*4 -- descending to the leaf element would under-report by 3x, a plausible wrong number rather than a refusal); and the VLA OBJECT form, whose size is FROZEN at the declaration (C 6.7.6.2p2) and must NOT move when `n` changes two lines later, while the type form on the very next line does. An implementation that conflated the object and type questions fails whichever way it conflated them. ✔MEASURED at this cycle's base b1f31420: every arm was `error[H_UnsupportedLoweringForKind]: sizeof of an incomplete or un-sizeable type`. ✔MEASURED 2026-09-04 with each reference invoked SEPARATELY: gcc 13.3.0 and clang 18.1.3 compile and RUN this exact source at `-std=c17` AND `-std=c2x`, both exiting 42; MSVC 19.44.35228 ABSTAINS (`error C2057: expected constant expression` on the bound plus `warning C4034: sizeof returns 0`), which is an abstention and not a vote against, so two accepting-and-running references make the disjunction require it. ⚠ MAIN IS A LEAF ON PURPOSE, and that is evidence rather than style: [[D-CSUBSET-VLA-NONLEAF-CALL-FRAME]] was OPEN when this was written, so a function holding a VLA OBJECT that also makes a CALL is refused (`L_VlaNonLeafFrameUnsupported`); arm 6 holds a VLA object, so the results are carried out on the exit code instead of printed. When that row closes this example can be rewritten to print. ⓘ The release arm emits one `X_OptFixpointTruncated` (0x2009) on the pe64 target -- the pass-schedule fixpoint honestly reporting it stopped on its iteration cap rather than on convergence, the same designed report `deep_brace_init_nest` and `staticlib_alignas_carry` carry. ✔MEASURED that it is a property of THIS program and not of the change: the same build of dsscp compiles `c99_vla_sizeof` under `release` with no such warning.
